notes:
# v1.4.7 - the app updates itself on launch

- Improved: the app now updates itself when it starts. When a new signed version
  is available it is downloaded and verified automatically in the background,
  without slowing down startup, and applied with a single automatic restart
  while the app is idle. If you are already using the app when the update is
  ready, it simply shows a "Restart to apply" option instead of restarting.
- Fixed: the update status now correctly reports when an update has been
  installed and is waiting for a restart. Previously it always said nothing was
  pending, even after an update was downloaded and verified.
- Note: the update is still signature-verified before it is applied, and a
  failed or interrupted update never blocks the app from starting.
- Note: no action needed on your part - just update and enjoy.
